Results of an analysis applied to networks per group

Source: R/groups.R
psychnet_result_group.Rd

A psychnet_result_group holds the results of an analysis applied to networks estimated per group, such as their centralities or bootstrapped edges: one result per group, keyed by group level, so that they can be printed together and combined into one table.

It is returned when a psychnet_group is passed to net_centralities(), net_predict(), net_boot(), net_stability(), net_casedrop_reliability() or net_split_reliability(). print() shows each group's result under a heading, and as.data.frame() stacks the groups' tables with a leading group column.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'psychnet_result_group'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'psychnet_result_group'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

A psychnet_result_group object.

...

Ignored by print(); passed by as.data.frame() to the as.data.frame() method of each group's result (for example what).

row.names, optional

Ignored.

Value

print() returns x invisibly, after printing each group's result under a group heading.

as.data.frame() returns the groups' tables, each converted by its own as.data.frame() method, stacked with a leading group column. An error in converting any group's result is raised, not skipped.

See also

psychnet_group for the networks; the analysis functions listed above for the columns of each table.

Examples

d <- rbind(data.frame(SRL_GPT, source = "GPT"),
           data.frame(SRL_Claude, source = "Claude"))
nets <- psychnet(d, method = "glasso", group = "source")
cent <- net_centralities(nets)
cent
#> <psychnet_centrality_group> 2 groups: GPT, Claude
#> 
#> --- GPT ---
#>   node  strength expected_influence
#> 1  CSU 1.1984512         1.19845117
#> 2   IV 1.0012765         1.00127649
#> 3   SE 0.8492185         0.84921854
#> 4   SR 1.2314317         0.53172852
#> 5   TA 0.6082238        -0.09147935
#> 
#> --- Claude ---
#>   node  strength expected_influence
#> 1  CSU 1.4794795          1.4794795
#> 2   IV 0.9920086          0.1598207
#> 3   SE 1.2652845         -0.3743445
#> 4   SR 1.9520259          1.0956629
#> 5   TA 1.3851959         -0.3340278
as.data.frame(cent)
#>     group node  strength expected_influence
#> 1     GPT  CSU 1.1984512         1.19845117
#> 2     GPT   IV 1.0012765         1.00127649
#> 3     GPT   SE 0.8492185         0.84921854
#> 4     GPT   SR 1.2314317         0.53172852
#> 5     GPT   TA 0.6082238        -0.09147935
#> 6  Claude  CSU 1.4794795         1.47947947
#> 7  Claude   IV 0.9920086         0.15982071
#> 8  Claude   SE 1.2652845        -0.37434447
#> 9  Claude   SR 1.9520259         1.09566294
#> 10 Claude   TA 1.3851959        -0.33402780
